subject.title: feat(macos): onboarding mascot reacts with moods, randomized idle behavior, and Easter eggs

question: Should the full mood-driven and interactive mascot experience ship across macOS onboarding, the macOS About screen, and the selected iOS hero surfaces?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but it establishes a broad permanent brand-motion and interaction direction that correctness evidence alone cannot approve.

options.title: Adopt after native validation
options.body: Keep the complete scope and land after exact-head native CI and one direct macOS onboarding interaction smoke.

options.title: Limit to onboarding
options.body: Keep mood-driven feedback in macOS onboarding but remove the About and iOS interactive opt-ins.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Retain the existing passive mascot until maintainers choose a narrower motion and interaction scope.

recommendation.title: Adopt after native validation
recommendation.body: Keep the complete scope and land after exact-head native CI and one direct macOS onboarding interaction smoke.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest item-specific product context and prior adjacent shared Apple UI history.
